intro: Elevate your space with the Auraline almirah. Smart shelves, generous hanging space, and a secure drawer come together to deliver style, function, and unmatched organisation.

features.title: A modern touch, sleek and bold
features.text: Riverside Riviera introduces a calm, sun-washed charm to the room. With pastel houses, drifting blossoms and a slow-turning Ferris wheel set against sky grey, it captures a city at ease and the textured finish adds a layer of warmth and elegance to your space.

features.title: Organise everything with ease
features.text: We know how important it is to keep your space tidy and organised. This almirah offers multiple spacious shelves, giving you ample room to store clothes, accessories, and more.

features.title: Keep valuables safe and secure
features.text: Your peace of mind matters. The secure drawer with a numeric lock ensures your valuables are safely stored, so you can focus on what truly matters.

features.title: Customised hanging rod for convenience
features.text: The hanging rod is thoughtfully placed at an ideal height, making it easier to reach your favourite outfits without hassle.

features.title: Hassle-free cleaning and upkeep
features.text: Cleaning is a breeze with the openable skirting, ensuring your almirah stays fresh and tidy without extra effort.

name: Auraline Women Premium Digital Printed 2-Door Steel Almirah Riverside Riviera Sky Grey
